policies.progress: Independent native persistent PlayerEffect instances count successful actual uses after the complete printed body. Void Souls and Tendrils start at explicit raw script1 and use local maximum10. Amirdrassil uses uncapped printed +1 progression with one frozen value for all four operations. Original owner progress survives source removal. Exact caps and recursive/notification windows remain M6 policies, not official calibration.
policies.void: Native complete Demon pool and exact printed-cost query, with no fallback or deletion of unknown eligible definitions. Stardust uses actual completed own hero attack, including final durability. Voidscale has only its printed Deathrattle at this fixed patch. Void Blast retains the actual HealthResult and original matching death cause to gate one Soul.
policies.wickerfang: Native Colossal and four complete existing leg faces. Original surviving friendly named legs positive stat-change contributions are copied via BuffCapturedMinion to the original body. Buff deltas and SetStats positive original-to-new max-stat differences are separate event shapes; negative-only changes and health damage do not grant. Exact named/linked scope and stat-operation windows remain M6.
policies.murlocs: Native repeatable QuestSpec goal6, actual own minion_summoned and current Murloc/ALL tribes. Rewards add independent persistent Sacred Cave instances. Native triggers capture before reward installation, so the completing summon is not retroactively buffed; new quest instance guards prevent old-cycle progress reuse. Current/printed tribes and reward checkpoints remain M6.
policies.cave: The complete actual noncollectible zero-cost SPELL reward face installs its persistent effect when played. The Quest directly installs that same native effect with its original quest source, without fabricating a reward spell cast or physical card.
policies.osk_health: Original chosen enemy MinionReference and remaining Health freeze on actual Battlecry. Successful native DestroyCapturedMinion gates original surviving Osk health gain and ordinary Hero GainMaxHealth. Later reentry cannot replace the original body. Health assignment and notification windows remain M6.
policies.osk_tendrils: FillHandWithCard uses actual native capacity and creates complete YOG_514 faces. YOG_514 is a required cross-series collectible dependency, not a Standard candidate root. CastFromPool uses the complete spell pool and ordinary automatic casts; no cached mutable state or virtual cast history.
policies.limits: TLC_452 base hand form and full variant rotation remain unimplemented. Only the two explicitly listed actual reachable faces are added. Formal pools, M0, M6 and full reachability remain open.
